purpose: Persist auto-ready execution candidates as deduplicated paper execution intents before any paper router or live router can act on them.

duplicate_detection.method: sha256 hash over source score/outcome, symbol, ticket type, action, quantity, order type, and account

interpretation.status: Auto-ready paper intents are now traceable and deduplicated.
interpretation.finding: The same auto gate input no longer creates new executable work after the first ledger run; every repeated candidate resolves to duplicate_existing_intent.
interpretation.recommendation: Next milestone should add a paper order router that consumes only pending_paper_execution intents, simulates fills, records paper positions, and moves ledger state forward.
